text.body: vakratuṇḍa mahākāya sūryakoṭisamaprabha | nirvighnaṃ kurū me deva sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā || 1 || śāṃtākāraṃ bhujagaśayanaṃ padmanābhaṃ sureśaṃ | viśvādhāraṃ gaganasadṛśaṃ meghavarṇaṃ śubhāṅgam | lakṣmīkāntaṃ kamalanayanaṃ yogibhirdhyānagamyam | vande viṣṇuṃ bhavabhayaharaṃ sarvalokaikanātham || 2 || kṛṣṇāya vāsudevāya haraye paramātmane | praṇatkleśanāśāya goviṃdāya namo namaḥ || 3 || yā kundeṃdutuṣārahāradhavalā yā śubhravastrāvṛtā | yā vīṇāvaradaṃḍamaṃḍitakarā yā śvetapadmāsanā | yā brahmācyutśaṃkaraprabhṛtibhiḥ devai sadā vanditā | sā māṃ pātu sarasvatī bhagavatī niḥśeṣajāḍayāpahā || 4 || brahmānaṃdaṃ paramasukhadaṃ kevalaṃ jñānamūrtim | dvaṃdvātītaṃ gaganasadṛśaṃ, tattvamasyādilakṣam | ekaṃ nityaṃ vimalamacalaṃ sarvadhīḥ sākṣībhūtam | bhāvātītaṃ triguṇarahitaṃ sadgurūṃ taṃ namāmi || 5 || gururbrahmā gururviṣṇuḥ gururdevo maheśvaraḥ | guruḥ sākṣāt parabrahma tasmai śrīguravai namaḥ || 6 || puṇyaśloko nalo rājā puṇyaśloko yudhiṣṭhiraḥ | puṇyaśloko videhaśca puṇyaśoko janārdanaḥ || 7 || ahilyā draupadī sītā tārā maṃdodarī tathā | paṃcakanyā nā smarennityaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 8 || aśvatthāmā balirvyāso hanumānaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ | kṛpaḥ paraśurāmaśca saptaite cirajīvinaḥ || 9 || ayodhyā mathurā māyā kāśī kāṃcī avaṃtikā | purī dvārāvatī caiva saptaitā mokṣadāyikāḥ || 10 || sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalye śive sarvārthasādhike śaraṇye tryaṃbake gauri nārāyaṇi namosstute || 11 ||
